cl.x: Provide SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2025, Version 01.03).

SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip is a premium grade one-component polyurethane construction adhesive with good initial grab and high strength after 30 minutes^. SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip is a versatile, fast curing, general purpose construction adhesive suitable for interior and exterior use.

cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2025, Version 01.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
cl.x: All surfaces must be clean and free from all dust, laitance, scale, rust, loose particles, grease and foreign matter.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2025, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.

s: Open Time: Relocation time is approximately 5~10 minutues depending on temperature and ventilation.
r: Relocation time is approximately 5~10 minutues depending on temperature and ventilation.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Product Information > Curing time
cl.x: Approximately 30 minutes for initial bond strength, depending on temperature, moisture content of surfaces and adhesive thickness. Some non-porous substrates (such as metal) may require 1 hour to reach initial bond strength. Strength will increase over the next 24 hours.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools
cl.x: 1. Cut end off cartridge nozzle at a 45° angle to give a 5- 6 mm bead. 2. Fit cartridge into a suitable Sika gun. 3. Apply adhesive in thin layers to one surface, or both surfaces if they are both very porous or absorbent. 4. Join surfaces within 5 minutes. A perfect fit is required for a watertight bond. 5. Clamp the substrates during adhesive cure. Clamp time is 30 minutes at +15°C to +20°C. Clamp for longer if the temperature is below +10°C or if the substrate is damp or non-porous. 6. Remove clamp when sufficient bond strength is achieved.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Clean up tools and equipment with acetone or white spirit. Cured adhesive can only be removed mechanically.

s: One or both of the materials to be bonded must be porous.
For non-porous substrates such as metal clamp for 1 hour.
A perfect fit of components is required for a watertight bond.
Surfaces may be damp or slightly moist, but all free liquid water must be removed.
Fastest bond time will be achieved with dry substrates. It is best practice to increase the clamp time when using damp materials.
Do not expose to direct sunlight or temperatures above 50°C or to freezing temperatures. Keep the product within the specified storage conditions.
